courses.subject: S S
courses.title: Honors Social Science: Methods and Theory
courses.description: Restricted to students in the Plan II Honors Program. An introduction to the study of the individual, society, or culture using the methods and theories of one of the Social Sciences. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Social Science 301 and 302C may not both be counted.
courses.restricted: Restricted to students in the Plan II Honors Program.

Social Science 301 and 302D may not both be counted.
courses.restricted: Restricted to students in the Plan II Honors Program.

courses.subject: S S
courses.title: Topics in Social Science
courses.description: This course is used to record credit the student earns while enrolled at another institution in a program administered by the University's Study Abroad Office. Credit is recorded as assigned by the study abroad adviser in the College of Liberal Arts. University credit is awarded for work in an exchange program; it may be counted as coursework taken in residence. Transfer credit is awarded for work in an affiliated studies program. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary.
